name: Nyx Online
storyline: Before the walls of Trivia, before the moon and before the first hero, there was only the night, and the night had a name: Nyx. Born from Chaos, she shaped the stone that came before stone and dug the depths of the world. Then Nyx wept, and no one knows why. Her few tears hardened into purple crystal and scattered across the continent. Today they are called the Tears of Nyx, so rare that when one appears, the whole land hears of it. Ancient things still stir in the dark corners of the world, and every new hero who leaves Trivia walks a little deeper into the night.
summary:
Nyx Online is a free-to-play online idle RPG made in hand-crafted pixel art. Your hero hunts on their own while you take care of gear, skills and strategy, and the world is shared: other players hunt beside you on the same maps, in real time.

Begin as a Novice in the city of Trivia and choose one of six paths: Warrior, Mage, Archer, Acolyte, Thief or Merchant. Each one branches into two advanced classes, from Knight, Paladin and Archmage to Sniper, Monk, Blacksmith and Alchemist.
